recommendation: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct + EvalPlus (HumanEval+ v0.1.10 and MBPP+ v0.2.0)
rationale: Short, executable Python tasks; public source and small downloadable data; simpler 28-day controlled harness-search audit than LiveCodeBench. Use as a protocol laboratory, not as evidence of contamination-free frontier capability.

proposed_evaluator.status: Source/version verified; not installed or executed in this session

reported_reference.configuration_evidence: Official instruct/eval_plus/test.sh uses greedy decoding, temperature=0, n_samples=1, bs=1, Qwen ChatML model_size=chat. It evaluates raw and sanitized generated outputs. model.py uses bf16, top_p=1.0 for greedy, max_new_tokens=2048, max_model_len=1536; exact matching environment is not fully pinned.
reported_reference.limits: These are paper-reported external reference numbers, not a measurement of the proposed v0.3.1 rerun and not this project’s results. The exact weights/engine snapshot behind the paper scores is not fully identified. Re-establish baseline B0 under the same frozen configuration as all experimental policies before making paired comparisons.

verified_conflicts: The EvalPlus leaderboard notes say MBPP+ v0.2.0 but retain obsolete 399-task text. The v0.2.0 release notes and downloaded data both establish 378 tasks.

The Qwen paper v3 LiveCodeBench table reports 18.2 for the 7B model, while nearby prose reports 37.6 and a 2407-2409 window. The blog mentions 2024.07-2024.11. Avoid these as an exact reference without further clarification.
Qwen official EvalPlus requirements pin 0.2.1; proposed EvalPlus 0.3.1 is a deliberate rerun setting, not an established source of the paper’s 84.1.
design_notes: Freeze weights, tokenizer, prompt adapter, sampling settings, token budgets, sanitation, timeout policy, evaluator and dataset SHA-256 before search.

Reserve MBPP+ task partitions for development/search/validation/final audit by a precommitted split. HumanEval+ can be a distinct external evaluation domain, but public data cannot establish model-training decontamination.
The reported 84.1% full HumanEval+ score must not be used as baseline for a new subset, stochastic decoding setup, retry policy or split. Run paired B0 on the exact same tasks and budget.

Greedy decoding seeds do not create independent task evidence. Repeat independent search runs/splits; treat tasks and run trajectories as appropriate units, report uncertainty without treating correlated repeats as fresh tasks.
Do not publish downloaded benchmark answer/test files into the harness-search environment. All test variants of one task stay in the same split.

For adversarial score-integrity claims, the scorer must not execute generated code in its own process. Use separate worker sandboxes and a trusted read-only evaluator; timeouts and malformed outputs count as failures.
